title.en: How to pick a good massage place in Bangkok
title.th: วิธีเลือกร้านนวดดี ๆ ในกรุงเทพฯ

body.en: Skip the lobby test. A polished entrance tells you about the owner's budget, not the therapist's hands — the fastest way to actually judge a place is in what its reviews say, not how its storefront looks.
body.th: อย่าตัดสินจากล็อบบี้ ทางเข้าที่สวยหรูบอกแค่งบของเจ้าของร้าน ไม่ได้บอกฝีมือของคนนวด แทนที่จะดูแบบนั้น ให้อ่านรีวิวและมองหารีวิวที่เอ่ยชื่อพนักงานคนใดคนหนึ่งโดยเฉพาะ — คำว่า 'ขอคนนี้' คือสัญญาณที่ชัดเจนที่สุดว่าร้านนี้มีพนักงานฝีมือดีอย่างสม่ำเสมอ เพราะแปลว่ามีคนจดจำชื่อนั้นไว้จริง ๆ คะแนนสูงพร้อมรีวิวสั้น ๆ ทั่วไปมีน้ำหนักน้อยกว่ารีวิว 4.6 ที่มีคนเขียนยาวถึงพนักงานคนเดียว
body.ko: 로비만 보고 판단하지 마세요. 화려한 입구는 사장님의 예산을 말해줄 뿐, 테라피스트의 실력을 말해주진 않아요. 대신 리뷰를 읽고 특정 직원을 콕 집어 언급한 리뷰를 찾으세요 — '이분으로 해주세요' 같은 표현은 그 업체에 꾸준히 실력 좋은 테라피스트가 있다는 가장 강력한 신호예요. 짧고 뻔한 5점 리뷰 여러 개보다, 특정 테라피스트에 대해 길게 쓴 4.6점 리뷰가 훨씬 신뢰할 만합니다.

en.heading: Read the reviews, not the storefront
en.body: A polished entrance tells you about the owner's budget, not the therapist's hands. The single strongest signal a place has a consistently good therapist is reviewers naming a specific person — 'ask for X' means someone cared enough to remember a name and come back for it. That's a much stronger signal than star rating alone.

en.heading: Weigh review quality, not just review count
en.body: A high star rating built on generic five-word reviews ('good service', 'nice place') is weaker evidence than a 4.6 with reviewers writing full paragraphs about one therapist by name. Volume matters less than specificity — ten vague five-star reviews tell you less than two detailed ones.

en.heading: Quick checklist before you book
en.body: Look for: reviews naming a specific therapist. Reviews describing what was actually done (technique, pressure, duration), not just "great!". A rating built on real photos and real service mentions, not stock interior shots. If two or three of these line up, you've found a place worth booking.

en.q: What's the single best signal a massage place in Bangkok is actually good?
en.a: Reviews that name a specific therapist by name. 'Ask for X' is the strongest signal a place has a consistently good therapist, because it means a real customer cared enough to remember and request that person again.

en.q: Does a high star rating mean the massage will be good?
en.a: Not on its own. A 4.9 rating built on generic five-word reviews is weaker evidence than a 4.6 with reviewers writing detailed paragraphs about a specific therapist. Read a handful of the actual review text, not just the number.
